title: Game launch / crash session detector (TABLED)
notes: DEFERRED — do not forget; pair with steam-fix-playbook. steam_launch_health(appid): parse ~/.steam/steam/logs/gameprocess_log.txt into sessions. Root launcher = first 'adding PID' line with quoted steam-launch-wrapper/reaper cmd; session ends at 'Remove <appid> from running list' — use root PID exit code (ignore child exit -1 noise). Signals: FAILED_START root exit 127/126/1 within ~30s; CRASH 139 (SIGSEGV) or 137 (SIGKILL); SUSPECT_SHORT root exit 0/130 but session <90s (flash quit); CLEAN 0 or 130 longer session. Secondary: content_log Files Corrupt (already), console-linux FATAL/dlopen failed, compatdata/*/logs, journalctl --user segfault after launch. Guidance insight game-needs-diag when last session FAILED_START/CRASH or 2+ SUSPECT_SHORT in 24h — route to steam-fix-playbook script (verify, libs, prefix reset). Diagnostics scan all installed AppIDs; show last exit + duration in Troubleshooting. Done partially today: _check_steam_logs bad exits but no session pairing or root-PID filter.

Pair with rule-pack-format diagnostics namespace.

title: Promote missing-tool diagnostics to tools.yaml
notes: Child of rule-packs · Guidance cards for optional tooling gaps. Promote from System scan: bin-missing-vulkaninfo / vulkan-tools (info, apt install vulkan-tools), winetricks missing (info, apt install winetricks). Overlaps mangohud-guidance-card (mangohud) — keep one card per binary; tools.yaml already has MangoHud + GameMode rules. Actions: copy apt line, link pop-runtimes-steam. title: Proton Wayland launch template rule
notes: DONE Jul 2026. steam.yaml proton-wayland-launch-fix: info-level general recommendation when session.wayland + game.proton + game.wayland_fix_missing (localconfig LaunchOptions + /proc proton env). Metrics in games.py + flatten_metrics. Deduped Wayland launch strings from gamemode/governor/resolution rules. Future home: game-general-options-ui.

title: Per-game general options (UI)
notes: New dashboard section separate from live Guidance/hot-warn cards. Per-game tunables on games list: launch options (Wayland→X11, GameMode, MangoHud), known Proton builds, optional presets. Click to copy or apply safe user-owned changes. First candidate: proton-wayland-launch-fix insight. Ties pop-display-wayland + pop-per-game-recipes. API: optional GET /api/game-options?appid= or embed in games payload. No auto-write to Steam localconfig v1 — copy/paste + confirm.

title: Community pack: GPU shader-bound + RAM EXPO verify
notes: Child of rule-packs · culled from pulse-default v1 — ship as optional community pack not builtin. gpu-shader-bound: tight detect (running game, busy≥92, mem_busy<45, cpu<78%, vram<75%, stutter≥35) — niche false-positive risk. ram-expo-verify: warn when live DRAM speed below EXPO profile (ties expo-detect backlog + mem_spec). Seed example pack rules/community/rdna3-pop or hardware-specific repo; document in rule-pack-format examples. Re-enable only when user installs pack.
